description: Partially updates an SMI subject via PATCH /subjects/:id. type (PERSON or COMPANY) is required on every call — the SMI backend requires it as a discriminator on every subject PATCH. Editable fields match the API contract: firstName/lastName (or companyName for a COMPANY), birthYear/birthMonth/birthDay, and gender. At least one editable field must be provided.

birthDay.description: The subject's updated day of birth. Treated as the day the company was founded, for a COMPANY subject.

birthMonth.description: The subject's updated birth month, as a number from 1 (January) to 12 (December). Treated as the month the company was founded, for a COMPANY subject.

birthYear.description: The subject's updated birth year. Treated as the year the company was founded, for a COMPANY subject.

companyName.description: The subject's updated company name, required whenever type is COMPANY.

firstName.description: The subject's updated first name, required whenever type is PERSON.

gender.description: The subject's updated gender (PERSON subjects only).

lastName.description: The subject's updated last name, required whenever type is PERSON.

subjectId.description: The SMI subject id to update, from a prior smi_get_subject call.

type.description: The subject's type. Required on every call as a discriminator, even when it isn't changing — SMI's PATCH endpoint rejects the request without it. PERSON for a person, COMPANY for a company or organization.

name: smi_update_subject
title: Update Subject
